## Download

| You have | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows | **AmbientLightSync-Windows.exe**: just double-click it |
| macOS | **AmbientLightSync-macOS.zip**: unzip, then right-click → Open the first time |
| Linux | **AmbientLightSync-Linux.tar.gz**: extract and run `./AmbientLightSync` |
| Python installed | **AmbientLightSync-Python.zip**: `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then double-click `Ambient Light.pyw` (Windows) or run `python app.py` |

No Python needed for the Windows/macOS/Linux downloads.

**First launch notes**
- Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the app isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- macOS will ask for **Screen Recording** permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security), which the app needs to read screen colours.
- Your computer and WiZ bulbs must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
